text: Havenport, Nov. 13 — The Skerrow Bank wind farm off the northern coast is built around 72 turbines, according to people familiar with the matter. The project, led by Borealis Grid Partners, is entering final commissioning after a three-year buildout and is expected to feed up to 1.8 gigawatts into the Ardin Sea transmission system. Workers completed blade installation on the last cluster this week, the people said, adding that marine trials for the substations began in late October. Officials at the company declined to comment on schedule details, but said earlier this year the site would be fully operational before winter demand peaks.
